NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.

intro.title: Welcome to your home page!
intro.text: Let me show you what is on this page. A few short steps follow, and you can close them any time with the X button.

task.title: A task from your teacher
task.text: Your teacher gave you this task. You can see which lesson it is, how long it takes, and when it is due. If there is a message, press Read aloud to hear it. The big button starts the lesson.

continue.title: Start here
continue.text: If you have had a lesson, continue the last one with one press. If not, choose: pick a ready-made course or build your own.

recent.title: Your earlier lessons
recent.text: Here are the courses you have already learned with. Press any row and the lesson opens again.

week.title: This week
week.text: Every day you learned gets a green tick. Today has an orange ring. It is fine to skip a day: your ticks stay.

create.title: Your own course
create.text: Here you can build your own course. You decide what to talk about with the tutor. You only answer four short questions.

classes.title: Your classes
classes.text: Here you see which classes you are in and who your teacher is. This box is always here on your home page.

join.title: Join with a code
join.text: If your teacher gave you a code, type it here and press Join. The code has six letters and numbers, for example ABC234.

howto.title: How a lesson goes
howto.text: This box shows in three steps how a lesson goes. After your first lesson it disappears, and you see your earlier lessons instead.

popular.title: Popular courses
popular.text: Many students use these courses. The orange button opens the lesson. The Save button keeps it for later, and you will find it on your Profile page.

menu.title: The menu
menu.text: From here you can go to the other pages any time: Home, Courses, New course and Profile. The page you are on is orange.

menuMobile.title: The menu
menuMobile.text: With the buttons at the bottom of the screen you can go to the other pages any time. The page you are on is orange.

help.title: Help any time
help.text: If you get stuck, press the Help button. These tips start again, and you can have each of them read aloud.

intro.title: A new course, step by step
intro.text: Four short questions, one at a time. You can always go back; what you typed stays.

steps.title: See where you are
steps.text: The bar at the top shows the steps. Finished ones get a tick.

read.title: Read aloud
read.text: If you would rather not read, press this button and we read the question to you.

next.title: Next
next.text: When you have answered, this button brings the next question. On the last step it creates the course.

intro.title: This is where you learn with the tutor
intro.text: On this page you talk with the AI tutor. Let me show you what everything is for. You can close this any time with the X button.

tutor.title: This is your tutor
tutor.text: The coloured circle is your tutor. When it speaks, waves move inside it. The bar below shows what is happening right now.

status.title: Who is speaking?
status.text: This bar always shows what is happening. Strong blue means it is your turn: speak calmly. Light blue means the tutor is speaking: listen.

timer.title: Where you are in the lesson
timer.text: The words and the bar show where you are: at the start, in the middle or near the end. The dot is you. We never count seconds, there is no rush, and you can end the lesson at any time.

start.title: How to start the lesson
start.text: Press this button. Your browser asks whether it may use the microphone: choose Allow. When you are done, you end the lesson with the same button.

mute.title: Pause
mute.text: If you need a break, press this button. The tutor cannot hear you then. To continue, press it again.

stuck.title: If you get stuck
stuck.text: If you do not understand something, say one of these sentences out loud. The tutor explains it another way, speaks more slowly, or gives an example.

transcript.title: Everything is written down
transcript.text: Here you can read what you both said, so you do not have to remember anything. The newest sentence is always at the bottom.

exit.title: Leaving
exit.text: This button takes you back to the courses. If the lesson is still running, press End lesson first.

reviewNote.title: Only you can see it
reviewNote.text: You made this course. You can use it already. If the check finds it fine, others will find it too.

report.title: If something is wrong
report.text: If the course is rude, hurtful or broken, use this button to tell us. An adult will look at it.

rules.title: What do we talk about?
rules.text: In the lesson we only talk about the topic. If you are in trouble, say so: your teacher will know, so they can help.

search.title: Search
search.text: Type a topic or a course name and the list narrows down by itself.

filter.title: By subject
filter.text: Here you can show the courses of a single subject only.

language.title: Lesson language
language.text: This label shows which language the tutor speaks: HU for Hungarian, EN for English.

bookmark.title: Saving
bookmark.text: Use the bookmark to save a course. You will find saved courses on your Profile page.

intro.title: This is your profile
intro.text: Here you can see your progress and your courses. You can also choose what feels comfortable for you. Let’s look at it together!

stats.title: Your progress
stats.text: These three numbers show how many courses you have had lessons in, how many courses you have built, and how many you have saved. They are only your numbers. We never compare you with anyone.

comfort.title: Make it comfortable
comfort.text: In this box you can choose how the pages look and work. Whatever you change here shows at once and is saved by itself.

size.title: Text size
size.text: You can see three letter A buttons. Click a bigger A, and all the text on the pages gets bigger. The smallest A brings back the normal size.

reading.title: Easy-reading text
reading.text: Switch this on to get more space between letters, words and lines. Many people find this easier to read. Click the switch to turn it on or off.

read.title: Read tips aloud
read.text: Switch this on, and the tips and the course builder steps read themselves aloud. You do not have to click the Read aloud button.

motion.title: Less motion
motion.text: If moving things bother you, switch this on. Then nothing on the pages will move or flash.

sample.title: Sample text
sample.text: This text shows how the letters look with your settings. Try things out until it feels comfortable!

reset.title: Default settings
reset.text: If you want everything back the way it was at the start, click this button.

classes.title: Your classes
classes.text: Here you see which classes you are in. If your teacher gave you a code, type it with the Join with a code button.

bookmarks.title: Saved courses
bookmarks.text: Click this row to open the list of your saved courses. You can save a course with the bookmark button on its card.

recent.title: Recent lessons
recent.text: Click this row to see the lessons you had lately. You can start them again from here.

courses.title: Your courses
courses.text: Click this row to open the courses you have built. You can start any of them again.

account.title: Your account
account.text: Click your picture to change your account details or to sign out.

intro.title: Plans
intro.text: This page shows the eNvolve plans.

plans.title: Choosing a plan
plans.text: Each card shows what the plan includes and what it costs. Before choosing a paid plan, talk it over with your parents or your teacher.

home.title: Lost?
home.text: This page does not exist. This button takes you back to the home page, or you can pick something from the menu above.

intro.title: Legal information
intro.text: Here you can read how we handle your data and what to keep in mind when using the app. If you have a question, the page tells you where to write.

intro.title: Your classes
intro.text: This is where you manage your classes. Create one under New class and you get a six-character code. Students join with it, and you assign courses to them.

code.title: Join code
code.text: Give this six-character code to your students, for example on the board. They type it on their home page. The Copy button puts it on the clipboard.

link.title: Link for students
link.text: Send this link to your students. It opens the join page with the code already filled in.

renew.title: New code
renew.text: If the code ended up in the wrong place, get a new one. The old code stops working at once; students who already joined stay in.

status.title: Where each student is
status.text: Next to every student you see their status: not started, in progress, done or stuck. The Overdue label means the due date has passed.

support.title: Support
support.text: Press Support to give this student slower speech, a shorter lesson or automatic read-aloud. You can also remove them from the class here.

preview.title: What the student sees
preview.text: This card appears exactly like this on the student’s home page. Every change shows on it right away.

intro.title: Join a class
intro.text: Here you can join your teacher’s class. You need a code from your teacher for this.

code.title: Type the code
code.text: The code has six letters and numbers, for example ABC234. Type it here and press Join. If you mistype it, no problem, just try again.

classes.title: Your classes
classes.text: Here you see which classes you are in and who your teacher is. If you do not need one any more, press Leave.

stuck.title: Needs attention
stuck.text: Students stuck in the last 30 days, from all your classes, and why. Click a name to open the class page.

classes.title: My classes
classes.text: Your classes. The red number shows how many students are stuck in each.

menu.title: The menu
menu.text: Overview, Classes, Library and Profile: everything your work needs.

menuMobile.title: The menu
menuMobile.text: On a phone, the bottom bar has Overview, Classes, Library and Profile.

help.title: Help
help.text: The Help button explains every page.

alerts.title: Lesson alerts
alerts.text: When a lesson left its topic, a rule was broken, or a student may need help, it shows up here with the student's name. You do not see what was said, because it is not stored.

assign.title: Assign
assign.text: Opens the assign form with this course already picked. With several classes it asks which one first.

try.title: Try it
try.text: Starts the lesson in preview so you can hear it. It is not added to any student statistics.

banner.title: Preview mode
banner.text: You see the same lesson as a student. Nothing you do here is recorded: it is not added to your or any student’s history.

reviewNote.title: Not in the library yet
reviewNote.text: Your own course can be used and assigned straight away. It appears in the library when the automatic check finds it fine.

report.title: Report
report.text: If a course is not suitable for children or is faulty, report it. As a teacher, one report takes it out of the library until an admin decides.

name.title: Your name for students
name.text: Students see this name on their task cards. Changing it updates all your classes.

comfort.title: Display
comfort.text: Text size, easy-reading text, read-aloud and less motion. They only change your own screen.

intro.title: Course for your class
intro.text: Four steps: subject, topic, voice and language, length. You can go back at any time; nothing you typed is lost. After saving you can try it and assign it.

attention.title: To do
attention.text: Reported, flagged and unchecked courses. Click to decide about them on the Courses page.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.text: Totals only: how many students, teachers and admins there are, how many courses are in the library and how many lessons there were this week. No names or conversations here.

menu.title: The menu
menu.text: Overview, Users, Courses and Profile: that is all you need as an admin.

menuMobile.title: The menu
menuMobile.text: On a phone, the bar at the bottom has Overview, Users, Courses and Profile.

help.title: Help
help.text: The Help button explains every page.

role.title: Change role
role.text: Give or take away the teacher or admin role here, with a short reason that goes into the log. The new role takes effect within a minute. You cannot change your own role.

intro.title: Course check
intro.text: An automatic filter checks new courses. Courses that were reported, flagged or could not be checked come here.

reports.title: Reports
reports.text: Why and by whom it was reported: one teacher's report or three students' take a course out of the library.

actions.title: Decide
actions.text: Adding to the library or hiding closes the reports. Feature recommends the course. Every decision goes into the log.

intro.title: Admin log
intro.text: Every admin decision is here: who, when, what and why. Nobody can change or delete the log.

security.title: Security
security.text: Whether two-step verification is on. Without it the admin pages stay locked.

bar.title: Preview and decide
bar.text: Try the lesson; nothing goes into any statistic. Here you see where the course stands and can decide about it: add to the library, hide, feature or delete.

help.title: The Help button
help.text: If something is not clear, press this button. I will show you, step by step, what everything on the page is for.

help.title: Help
help.text: Short explanations for every page are here. They only appear when you click.

intro.title: Lesson safety
intro.text: How many lessons ended because of drift, a rule break or a call for help. Nobody sees the conversations.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.text: The numbers for the last 30 days, the most serious first, including how many signs of danger the teacher has already opened.

list.title: Stopped lessons
list.text: Lessons stopped because of a sign of danger or a rule break show the student's name, so none goes unnoticed. The teacher sees them too and can mark them as false alarms.

intro.title: Hi! This is eNvolve
intro.text: Here you learn by talking with an AI tutor. You pick the topic, the tutor explains it and asks you questions too.
intro.point1: You can ask as many questions as you like.
intro.point2: There are no grades, and there is no need to hurry.

lesson.title: How a lesson works
lesson.step1: Pick a course, or build a new one.
lesson.step3: Talk with the tutor. When you are done, press End Session.
lesson.note: During the lesson, a line of text always shows whether the tutor is talking or it is your turn.

mic.title: Let's test your microphone
mic.text: In a lesson you talk out loud with the tutor, so you need a microphone. When you press the button, your browser asks for permission. Choose Allow.
mic.asking: Look at the top of your browser and choose Allow.
mic.heard: I can hear you! Your microphone works.
mic.deniedHelp: Click the lock icon at the left of the address bar, find Microphone and set it to Allow. Then reload the page.
mic.unavailable: We could not find a microphone. Plug one in, or try another browser.
mic.later: You can also do this later, before your first lesson.

ready.title: You're ready!
ready.text: Start with your own course, or pick one that already exists. If you get stuck, the question mark button in the menu bar is always there to help.

demo.title: Spoken introduction
demo.text: If you like, a voice explains in 2–3 minutes how the app works, and you can ask it questions too. You need your microphone for this.
demo.yourTurn: Your turn, feel free to ask
demo.micBlockedHelp: Click the lock icon at the left of the address bar, set Microphone to Allow, then reload the page.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.description: This is not your fault. Try again, and if it still does not work, come back a little later.

intro.title: Welcome to eNvolve for teachers!
intro.text: Here you assign courses to your students, who learn by talking with an AI tutor. You see where each of them is and who is stuck, never the conversations.

steps.title: How it works
steps.step1: Create a class. You get a six-character code for it.
steps.step2: Give your students the code or the link. They join on their home page.
steps.step3: Assign a course with a due date and follow everyone’s progress on the Overview.

ready.title: Let’s start!
ready.text: Create your first class, or look around the Library first. The Help button explains every page.

AdminHome.leadTodo: {count, plural, one {# thing needs} other {# things need}} your attention.
AdminHome.leadCalm: Nothing to do. Here are the numbers and the latest admin decisions.
AdminHome.todoNone: Every course has a decision; nothing is reported or flagged.
AdminHome.flagged: {count, plural, one {# course was} other {# courses were}} reported or flagged by the filter
AdminHome.flaggedHint: They are not in the library until you decide.
AdminHome.unchecked: {count, plural, one {# course is} other {# courses are}} unchecked
AdminHome.uncheckedHint: The automatic filter did not run on them (for example, its key is missing).
AdminHome.capped: Many users: the counts per role come from the newest 500 accounts.
AdminHome.violations: {count, plural, one {# stopped lesson} other {# stopped lessons}} no teacher has opened yet
AdminHome.violationsHint: Stopped because of a sign of danger or a rule break.
AdminHome.safetyError: The lesson safety numbers did not load. Refresh the page, and tell the developer if that does not help.

AdminUsers.title: Users
AdminUsers.lead: Search by email or name, and choose who is a teacher or an admin. Every role change goes into the admin log.

roleHint.student: Own courses, lessons, joining a class

AdminUsers.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. teacher at the pilot school
AdminUsers.reasonRequired: Write a short reason (at least 3 characters).
AdminUsers.saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
AdminUsers.adminWarning: An admin can change anyone's role and decides about courses. Only give it to someone you fully trust.

AdminCourses.title: Course check
AdminCourses.lead: A new course goes into the library when the automatic filter finds it fine. Courses that were reported, flagged by the filter or could not be checked come here.

empty.public: No courses in the library yet.
empty.featured: No recommended courses yet. Recommend courses in the library with Feature.

AdminCourses.deleteQuestion: Delete for sure? Its assignments are deleted too.
AdminCourses.actionError: Could not save. Please try again.
AdminCourses.barNote: Preview as an admin: try the lesson and decide about the course here.

AdminLog.title: Admin log
AdminLog.lead: Every admin decision: who, when, what and why. Nobody can change or delete the log.

AdminProfile.twoFactorOff: Two-step verification is off, so the admin pages are locked.
AdminProfile.securityText: An admin account can change anyone's role, so a second step (an authenticator app) is needed besides the password.

TwoFactor.title: Turn on two-step verification
TwoFactor.text: The admin pages only open with two-step verification, because an admin account can change anyone's role.
TwoFactor.step2: Under Security, add an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator) and scan the QR code.
TwoFactor.step3: Enter the code from the app, then reload this page.
TwoFactor.note: If the option does not appear, multi-factor authentication still has to be turned on in the Clerk dashboard.

Safety.title: Lesson alerts

category.off_topic: Kept switching to other topics, so the lesson ended.
category.override: Asked the tutor to ignore its rules or to play another role, so the lesson ended.
category.inappropriate: Asked for or said something not suitable for children, so the lesson ended.
category.hurtful: Used hurtful or rude words, so the lesson ended.
category.home: Said something in the lesson that may mean they are hurt at home. The lesson ended.
category.self: Said something in the lesson that may mean they want to hurt themselves. The lesson ended.
category.bullying: Said something in the lesson that may mean others hurt or tease them. The lesson ended.
category.danger: Said something in the lesson that may mean they are in danger. The lesson ended.
